readme.heading: Password Manager data export
readme.intro: This archive is the complete copy of your data we hold for you. It is provided to satisfy GDPR (and equivalent) data-portability rights.
readme.formatBody: Files ending in .json are machine-readable; files ending in .csv open in any spreadsheet.
readme.zeroKnowledgeBody: Password Manager never sees your master password and cannot decrypt your vault. Vault entries below are stored as ciphertext (ciphertext, nonce, auth tag, wrapped data key). To read them, open this archive inside a Password Manager client using your master password.
readme.rightsBody: You can request an export at any time, revoke an active download link from your settings, and delete your account entirely from the security settings page.
readme.contactBody: For privacy questions, contact your instance administrator.
